about.heading: Architecting interfaces with precision & curiosity.
about.story1: I'm a Software Engineering student at Fergana State Technical University, deeply passionate about crafting modern, intuitive digital interfaces. My journey started with foundational web technologies and has steadily evolved into building production-grade React applications with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
about.story2: Beyond coursework, I invest significant time exploring the broader frontend ecosystem — studying design systems, component architecture patterns, and animation frameworks like Framer Motion. I believe that great software sits at the intersection of technical precision and thoughtful design.
about.story3: My goal is to contribute to meaningful software products that people genuinely enjoy using — combining engineering depth with strong visual intuition.
about.card1Desc: Software Engineering curriculum at Fergana State Technical University.
about.card2Desc: Dedicated to building beautiful, performant, and accessible web interfaces.
about.card3Desc: Design systems, motion design, and UI architecture deeply interest me.
about.card4Desc: Constantly exploring new frameworks, tools, and engineering principles.

HTML5.description: Semantic document architecture, accessibility standards (a11y), and modern SEO foundations.

CSS3 / Modern CSS.description: Responsive layouts, Flexbox, Grid, custom properties, and smooth micro-interactions.

JavaScript (ES6+).description: Modern asynchronous JavaScript, DOM manipulation, closures, promises, and functional patterns.

React.description: Component architecture, declarative UI state, custom hooks, and modern frontend ecosystems.

TypeScript.description: Static type systems, strict interfaces, generics, and type-safe component development.

Tailwind CSS.description: Utility-first design systems, custom theme configuration, and responsive layout mastery.

Git.description: Version control, branching workflows, commits, rebasing, and merge conflict resolution.

GitHub & GitHub CLI.description: Repository management, automated remote pushes, CLI tooling (`gh`), and collaborative workflows.

Vite.description: Next-generation frontend tooling, lightning-fast HMR, and optimized production bundling.

Framer Motion.description: Declarative page transitions, gesture animations, spring physics, and scroll-driven reveals.
